entities.name: Jelena Blagojević
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jelena Blagojević is a Serbian professional volleyball player and two-time Olympian. She plays for Serbia women's national volleyball team. She competed in the 2012 Summer Olympics in London, United Kingdom. She also competed in the 2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo, Japan and won a bronze medal. She is 1.81 m tall. She plays for KS DevelopRes Rzeszów in Poland.
